source_quote: - Improving the energy efficiency of electrical appliances and equipment - Improving the energy efficiency of different modes of transportation - Improving energy efficiency in buildings, and adopting and implementing the National Green Building Code for new and existing buildings and communities
extraction_rationale: Specific end-use and building-code efficiency policies.

parent_statement: Maximizing energy efficiency
policy_statement: Promote energy management systems and smart-city digital transformation to reduce energy consumption.
source_quote: - Promoting energy management systems at all levels (systems and institutions) - Encouraging the trend towards establishing smart cities and digital transformation that contributes to reducing energy consumption in addition to providing a sustainable environment
extraction_rationale: Named management and smart-city interventions for energy-use reduction.

policy_statement: Adopt sustainable consumption and production trends to reduce greenhouse gas emissions from non-energy activities.
source_quote: Objective (1.d): Adopt sustainable consumption and production trends for reduction of greenhouse gas emissions from other non-energy activities Sectors such as agriculture and waste also represent significant contributing percentages to the of total greenhouse gases, as the contribution of each of them amounted to about 9% of the 2018 rates.
section_header: Objective (1.d): Adopt sustainable consumption and production trends for reduction of greenhouse gas emissions from other non-energy activities
extraction_rationale: Umbrella mitigation objective for agriculture and waste.

parent_statement: Adopt sustainable consumption and production trends for reduction of greenhouse gas emissions from other non-energy activities
policy_statement: Reduce agricultural greenhouse gas emissions using modern technologies, feeding systems, and crops with low water needs.
source_quote: - Reducing greenhouse gas emissions from agricultural activities, such as animal production activities, through the use of modern technologies and various feeding systems and the use of crops with low water needs
section_header: Objective (1.d): Adopt sustainable consumption and production trends for reduction of greenhouse gas emissions from other non-energy activities
extraction_rationale: Direct agricultural emissions-reduction policy with named mechanisms.

parent_statement: Adopt sustainable consumption and production trends for reduction of greenhouse gas emissions from other non-energy activities
policy_statement: Promote 4Rs waste management, safe landfill disposal, and landfill gas collection.
source_quote: - Promote the concept of the ‹4Rs› which is to reduce, reuse, recycle and recover municipal and agricultural waste - Safe and proper disposal of solid waste in suitable landfills and collection of gases resulting from those landfills
section_header: Objective (1.d): Adopt sustainable consumption and production trends for reduction of greenhouse gas emissions from other non-energy activities
extraction_rationale: Specific waste resource-efficiency and landfill-gas mitigation actions.

parent_statement: Adopt sustainable consumption and production trends for reduction of greenhouse gas emissions from other non-energy activities
policy_statement: Adopt supportive policies to reduce waste at source, including limiting single-use plastic and using fewer or reusable packaging materials.
source_quote: - Encouraging supportive policies to reduce waste from the source, such as limiting the use of single-use plastic and using fewer or reusable packaging materials.
section_header: Objective (1.d): Adopt sustainable consumption and production trends for reduction of greenhouse gas emissions from other non-energy activities
extraction_rationale: Policy reform targeting waste prevention.

policy_statement: Develop incentive policies for electric cars, charging stations, and local battery production.
source_quote: - Developing additional incentive policies to expand the use of electric cars and expanding the establishment of charging stations for electric car batteries, with the expansion of the production of such batteries locally
extraction_rationale: Concrete financial incentive policy for low-emission transport.

policy_statement: Facilitate private-sector self-use high-efficiency cogeneration or renewable power plants.
source_quote: - Providing facilitations to the private sector in establishing a power plant for selfuse within the space, provided that they are high-efficiency co-generation plants or renewable energy plants
extraction_rationale: Financial facilitation for renewable and efficient generation.

policy_statement: Expand natural gas use in petrochemicals and facilitate solar thermal energy in the industrial sector.
source_quote: - Expanding the use of natural gas in the petrochemical industry to maximize its value and to provide facilitations for the use of solar thermal energy as an alternative in the industrial sector.
extraction_rationale: Specific industrial fuel and renewable heat enabling policy; includes facilitations.

policy_statement: Adopt and activate local and global green building codes.
source_quote: - Adopting and activating the local and global green building codes
extraction_rationale: Code-based building efficiency policy.

policy_statement: Develop incentive policies for biofuel use in transport.
source_quote: - Developing incentive policies to encourage the use of biofuels in the transport sector
extraction_rationale: Financial incentive policy for low-carbon fuels.

policy_statement: Reassess and operationalize approved industrial energy-efficiency studies and plans.
source_quote: - Reassessing all studies and plans for improving energy efficiency in the industrial sector and operationalizing what will be approved of them
extraction_rationale: Concrete planning-to-implementation commitment for industrial energy efficiency.

policy_statement: Study ways to encourage local manufacture of renewable energy equipment across the value chain.
source_quote: - The National Council for Climate Change (NCCC) to study various ways to encourage the local manufacture of renewable energy equipment (focusing on solar thermal energy and photovoltaic cells) in all parts of the value chain.
extraction_rationale: Concrete supply-chain enabling study for renewable energy; phrased as study rather than deployment.

policy_statement: Support carbon-emissions calculation and emissions reduction by civil society institutions.
source_quote: - Encouraging civil society institutions to calculate carbon emissions for various activities and allocating appropriate support to reduce these emissions
extraction_rationale: Carbon accounting plus resource support for emissions reduction.

policy_statement: Support, finance, and incubate emerging companies providing smart solutions that rationalize electricity use and increase efficiency.
source_quote: - Enabling smart applications and systems in various sectors such as the energy sector by supporting, financing and incubating emerging companies to provide smart solutions in those sectors that would rationalize the use of electricity, increase its efficiency and increase its productivity.
extraction_rationale: Funding/incubation policy for energy-efficiency technologies.

policy_statement: Study adoption of green procurement standards.
source_quote: - Studying the possibility of adopting green procurement standards
extraction_rationale: Standards-based procurement policy proposal; preliminary because phrased as a study.

policy_statement: Protect citizens from negative health impacts of climate change.
source_quote: Based on this principle, the importance of protecting citizens from the negative health impacts of climate change, especially at the cusp of the Covid-19 pandemic, is evident. This showed how important it is to prepare well for emergency health variables and join efforts in the various relevant sectors to try to manage the crisis well and limit the negative impacts on citizens.
section_header: Objective (2.a): Protect citizens from the negative health impacts of climate change
extraction_rationale: Umbrella adaptation objective with specific health preparedness actions.

parent_statement: Protect citizens from the negative health impacts of climate change
policy_statement: Improve health services, infrastructure, health teams, preventive services, and health access for climate-related health risks.
source_quote: - Improving health services and increasing the health sector's preparedness to face diseases caused by climate change - Availability of an appropriate infrastructure that can provide health care to targeted individuals and communities - Developing and supporting preventive services, especially those related to vaccination and immunization against infection
section_header: Objective (2.a): Protect citizens from the negative health impacts of climate change
extraction_rationale: Specific public-health adaptation package.

parent_statement: Protect citizens from the negative health impacts of climate change
policy_statement: Study climate impacts on pathogens and establish epidemiological forecasting, surveillance, MRV, and health mapping for climate-related diseases.
source_quote: - Studying the impact of climate change on the kinds and activities of bacteria, parasites, fungi and viruses currently present - Epidemiological forecasting or proactive surveillance of emergencies related to climate change - Making a health map for diseases related to climate change
section_header: Objective (2.a): Protect citizens from the negative health impacts of climate change
extraction_rationale: Named research, surveillance, and mapping interventions for climate-health risk.

parent_statement: Protect citizens from the negative health impacts of climate change
policy_statement: Establish early warning systems and control programs for climate-related health effects.
source_quote: - Establishing an effective early warning system and control programs for the related health effects
section_header: Objective (2.a): Protect citizens from the negative health impacts of climate change
extraction_rationale: Specific climate-health early warning intervention.

parent_statement: Protect citizens from the negative health impacts of climate change
policy_statement: Direct special attention, awareness, nutrition, and alternative-livelihood support to vulnerable groups.
source_quote: - Directing special attention to citizens with special risk factors, such as women, especially pregnant and lactating women, children, people with special needs, the elderly and the sick. - Developing support programs for the affected groups and emphasizing the finding of alternative livelihoods, especially for women in the poorest areas and those least able to search for alternative livelihoods
section_header: Objective (2.a): Protect citizens from the negative health impacts of climate change
extraction_rationale: Targeted vulnerability-reduction and support measures for climate health impacts.

parent_statement: Protect citizens from the negative health impacts of climate change
policy_statement: Apply structural cooling measures such as painting facades and roofs white to reduce heat.
source_quote: - Enhancing work on applying some structural mitigation measures to reduce temperature and its impacts on citizens, as it is possible to paint the facades of houses and roofs with a white color that reflects rays and helps reduce heat
section_header: Objective (2.a): Protect citizens from the negative health impacts of climate change
extraction_rationale: Specific heat-adaptation measure.

policy_statement: Minimize loss and damage to country assets and ecosystems from climate change.
source_quote: Preserving state assets, such as infrastructure and historical heritage monuments from the impacts of climate change is one of the most important strategic goals due to its great social, economic and cultural dimensions. The preservation of ecosystems is also of paramount importance to maintain the ecological balance and prevent negative social, health and economic impacts that may result from a disturbance in that balance.
section_header: Objective (2.b): Minimize loss and damage to country assets and ecosystems by preserving them from the impacts of climate change
extraction_rationale: Umbrella adaptation objective covering assets and ecosystems.

parent_statement: Minimize loss and damage to country assets and ecosystems by preserving them from the impacts of climate change
policy_statement: Prioritize adaptation measures and technology areas for support and expertise transfer.
source_quote: - Determining the priorities of the proposed adaptation measures for all concerned sectors, and identifying the technological areas to be supported and developed through transfer of expertise from the international community
section_header: Objective (2.b): Minimize loss and damage to country assets and ecosystems by preserving them from the impacts of climate change
extraction_rationale: Concrete adaptation planning and technology-transfer action.

parent_statement: Minimize loss and damage to country assets and ecosystems by preserving them from the impacts of climate change
policy_statement: Improve ecosystem adaptive capacity, address biodiversity loss and ecosystem degradation, and preserve reserves and endemic species.
source_quote: - Improving the adaptive capacity of ecosystems - Promoting a coherent approach to address biodiversity loss, climate change and land and ecosystem degradation - Preserving reserves and endemic species
section_header: Objective (2.b): Minimize loss and damage to country assets and ecosystems by preserving them from the impacts of climate change
extraction_rationale: Ecosystem-based adaptation and conservation action.

parent_statement: Minimize loss and damage to country assets and ecosystems by preserving them from the impacts of climate change
policy_statement: Preserve historical and cultural heritage from negative climate impacts and locate new development communities away from vulnerable hotspots using mathematical modeling.
source_quote: - Preserving the historical and cultural heritage from the negative impacts of climate change - Choosing the locations of new development communities away from hotspots most vulnerable to the impacts of climate change using mathematical modeling
section_header: Objective (2.b): Minimize loss and damage to country assets and ecosystems by preserving them from the impacts of climate change
extraction_rationale: Asset-protection and climate-risk-informed spatial planning actions.

policy_statement: Preserve Egypt's natural resources from climate change impacts.
source_quote: Therefore, it is necessary to preserve them from the threats of climate change and maximize their utilization as much as possible. The following directions contribute to achieving this objective:
section_header: Objective (2.c): Preserving the country›s resources from the impacts of climate change
extraction_rationale: Umbrella adaptation and resource-management objective.

parent_statement: Preserving the country›s resources from the impacts of climate change
policy_statement: Reduce waste and improve efficiency of water, energy, food, land, and supply-chain resource use.
source_quote: - Develop policies to reduce waste and raise the efficiency of water resource use - Using more efficient technologies to rationalize water and energy consumption and reduce food waste - Strengthen supply chains and logistics systems to reduce wastage during shipping and handling
section_header: Objective (2.c): Preserving the country›s resources from the impacts of climate change
extraction_rationale: Resource-efficiency measures within an adaptation objective.

parent_statement: Preserving the country›s resources from the impacts of climate change
policy_statement: Develop water harvesting, rainwater collection, flood-water harvesting, efficient irrigation, wastewater recycling, and non-conventional water resources.
source_quote: - Development of water harvesting and rainwater collecting systems - Encouraging and implementing flood water harvesting systems and its utilization - Use more efficient irrigation systems - Increasing the coverage of sewage treatment plants and industrial wastewater in different areas to recycle water, maintain its quality and maximize its use
section_header: Objective (2.c): Preserving the country›s resources from the impacts of climate change
extraction_rationale: Specific water adaptation and resource-efficiency package.

parent_statement: Preserving the country›s resources from the impacts of climate change
policy_statement: Maintain and disinfect fresh water sources and improve service coverage for poor rural areas.
source_quote: - Carrying out maintenance and disinfection work for fresh water sources (canals and drains) on an ongoing basis and to cover as many of them as possible - Ensuring that services cover the poorest rural areas in order to reduce the effort made, especially by women, to obtain resources such as fresh water and improve the efficiency of resource access
section_header: Objective (2.c): Preserving the country›s resources from the impacts of climate change
extraction_rationale: Concrete water-resource protection and access measures.

parent_statement: Preserving the country›s resources from the impacts of climate change
policy_statement: Develop productive crop varieties tolerant to high temperatures, salinity and drought with low water consumption, and improve crop management.
source_quote: - Develop different varieties and hybrids of strategic crops that are highly productive and tolerant to adverse weather conditions (high temperatures, salinity and drought) and have low water consumption, to counter the negative impacts of climate change. - Improving crop management systems
section_header: Objective (2.c): Preserving the country›s resources from the impacts of climate change
extraction_rationale: Specific agricultural adaptation to named climate hazards with water efficiency.

parent_statement: Preserving the country›s resources from the impacts of climate change
policy_statement: Preserve agricultural land and water resources, expand agricultural land, rationalize agricultural water use, and reuse agricultural wastewater.
source_quote: - Preserving agricultural land and water resources by maintaining the fertility of agricultural soil continuously - Allocating new agricultural lands to increase the agricultural area - Rationalizing water consumption in agriculture and reuse of agricultural wastewater
section_header: Objective (2.c): Preserving the country›s resources from the impacts of climate change
extraction_rationale: Land and water resource-management actions for climate resilience.

parent_statement: Preserving the country›s resources from the impacts of climate change
policy_statement: Protect fisheries and integrate biodiversity into impact, vulnerability, and adaptation assessments.
source_quote: - Protection of fisheries - Identify ways and means to integrate biodiversity considerations into assessments of impacts, vulnerability, and climate change adaptation.
section_header: Objective (2.c): Preserving the country›s resources from the impacts of climate change
extraction_rationale: Biodiversity and fisheries adaptation measures.

parent_statement: Preserving the country›s resources from the impacts of climate change
policy_statement: Encourage local production of water-saving sanitary ware and fixtures.
source_quote: - Encouraging local production for the production of sanitary ware and fixtures that apply international water saving standards
section_header: Objective (2.c): Preserving the country›s resources from the impacts of climate change
extraction_rationale: Specific water-efficiency manufacturing and standards measure.

policy_statement: Make infrastructure and services resilient to climate impacts including sea level rise, precipitation concentration, and temperature increase.
source_quote: Given the importance of these services, it must be ensured that they are ready to deal with the various impacts expected from climate changes, such as sea level rise, precipitation concentration and temperature increase. The following directions contribute to achieving this objective:
section_header: Objective (2.d): Resilient infrastructure and services in the face of climate change impacts
extraction_rationale: Umbrella adaptation objective with named hazards.

parent_statement: Resilient infrastructure and services in the face of climate change impacts
policy_statement: Prioritize adaptation measures and technology support for climate-vulnerable infrastructure including coastal airports.
source_quote: - Determining the priorities of the proposed adaptation measures for all concerned sectors, and identifying the technological areas to be supported and developed through transfer of expertise from the international community including the civil aviation sector and airports, especially coastal airports, that are vulnerable to damage as a result of the impacts of climate change
section_header: Objective (2.d): Resilient infrastructure and services in the face of climate change impacts
extraction_rationale: Adaptation planning and technology support for vulnerable infrastructure.

parent_statement: Resilient infrastructure and services in the face of climate change impacts
policy_statement: Protect coastal lowlands and implement integrated coastal zone management.
source_quote: - Protecting coastal lowland and implementing integrated coastal zone management
section_header: Objective (2.d): Resilient infrastructure and services in the face of climate change impacts
extraction_rationale: Specific coastal adaptation action.

parent_statement: Resilient infrastructure and services in the face of climate change impacts
policy_statement: Implement flood protection systems and strengthen sewage and rain drainage systems.
source_quote: - Implementing flood protection systems in areas prone to the phenomenon - Strengthening sewage and rain drainage systems in cities and villages
section_header: Objective (2.d): Resilient infrastructure and services in the face of climate change impacts
extraction_rationale: Specific flood and drainage adaptation interventions.

parent_statement: Resilient infrastructure and services in the face of climate change impacts
policy_statement: Improve water, sanitation, roads, rural infrastructure, agricultural-project planning, and healthcare facilities for climate resilience.
source_quote: - Improving water and sanitation systems and services, particularly in hotspots and underserved areas most vulnerable to the impacts of climate change and establishing of environmentally compatible sewage stations in the Nile Marinas - Improving roads to be more resilient to the impacts of climate change such as high temperatures, floods and sea level rise - Infrastructure development for healthcare facilities
section_header: Objective (2.d): Resilient infrastructure and services in the face of climate change impacts
extraction_rationale: Concrete infrastructure resilience measures responding to named climate hazards.

policy_statement: Implement disaster risk reduction concepts for climate risks.
source_quote: Taking into account the extent of the impact of climate change and Egypt's status as one of the most affected countries, the aim of the objective is to ensure that there are means of forecasting and warning followed by actions taken on the ground to address these risks. The following directions contribute to achieving this objective:
section_header: Objective (2.e): Implementation of disaster risk reduction concepts
extraction_rationale: Umbrella risk-reduction adaptation policy.

parent_statement: Implementation of disaster risk reduction concepts
policy_statement: Establish sectoral early warning systems using a unified database and ministry climate change information centers.
source_quote: - Establishing early warning systems for all sectors by developing a unified database. The database can be established by activating the role of climate change information centers affiliated with various ministries.
section_header: Objective (2.e): Implementation of disaster risk reduction concepts
extraction_rationale: Specific early warning and climate information system intervention.

parent_statement: Implementation of disaster risk reduction concepts
policy_statement: Establish monitoring systems and study biodiversity adaptation activities in areas exposed to floods and rains.
source_quote: - Establishing regular monitoring systems - Studies to determine the impacts, benefits and potential benefits of adaptation activities related to biological diversity, especially in areas exposed to the risk of floods and rains.
section_header: Objective (2.e): Implementation of disaster risk reduction concepts
extraction_rationale: Risk monitoring and biodiversity adaptation for named hazards.

parent_statement: Implementation of disaster risk reduction concepts
policy_statement: Raise personnel and societal awareness of climate risks and promote inclusive crisis-management planning.
source_quote: - Raising awareness and efficiency of personnel working in the sectors concerned with addressing the risks of climate change - Raising societal awareness of the potential risks of climate change and means of dealing with them, with a focus on spreading awareness among vulnerable groups of women and children - Emphasizing the importance of community participation from all groups and equality among all during the development of crisis management plans
section_header: Objective (2.e): Implementation of disaster risk reduction concepts
extraction_rationale: Capacity-building and crisis-planning intervention for climate risk reduction.

parent_statement: Implementation of disaster risk reduction concepts
policy_statement: Strengthen and develop social protection, compensation, and insurance funds against natural disasters.
source_quote: - Strengthening and developing channels and funds for social protection, compensation and insurance against natural disasters
section_header: Objective (2.e): Implementation of disaster risk reduction concepts
extraction_rationale: Financial risk-transfer and social protection policy.

policy_statement: Preserve and expand green spaces and afforestation to absorb carbon dioxide and reduce thermal stress.
source_quote: Afforestation and the increase of green spaces contribute to the absorption of carbon dioxide from the atmosphere and reduction of thermal stress, especially with the rise in temperatures as a result of climate change. Accordingly, preserving and expanding green spaces contribute to the reduction of GHG emissions and are an adaptation to the negative impacts of rising temperatures.
section_header: Objective (2.f): Preserving and expanding green spaces
extraction_rationale: Nature-based policy with explicit carbon absorption and heat-adaptation mechanisms.

parent_statement: Preserving and expanding green spaces
policy_statement: Increase green spaces and afforestation in new urban cities, densely populated areas, and high-temperature areas.
source_quote: - Increasing the area of green spaces and afforestation in all new urban cities - Increasing the rate of afforestation in all cities, especially densely populated areas and high temperature areas
section_header: Objective (2.f): Preserving and expanding green spaces
extraction_rationale: Specific urban greening and afforestation intervention.

parent_statement: Preserving and expanding green spaces
policy_statement: Promote urban agriculture and rooftop farming as climate change impact mitigation.
source_quote: Spreading the culture of urban agriculture and rooftop farming as a means of climate change impacts mitigation.
section_header: Objective (2.f): Preserving and expanding green spaces
extraction_rationale: Specific nature-based urban intervention explicitly linked to climate mitigation.

policy_statement: Strengthen women’s response considerations to help them adapt to climate change.
source_quote: Objective (2.g): Strengthening women›s response considerations to help them adapt to climate change The considerations of women›s response are an important factor in the considerations of combating climate change, given the importance of the role of women in the Egyptian society and being more vulnerable to climate change, especially in rural and less educated societies.
section_header: Objective (2.g): Strengthening women›s response considerations to help them adapt to climate change
extraction_rationale: Gender-focused adaptation objective with listed actions.

parent_statement: Strengthening women›s response considerations to help them adapt to climate change
policy_statement: Reflect women's needs in climate technology, mitigation and adaptation programs, capacity building, finance, credit, and training.
source_quote: - Providing flexible financing mechanisms that reflect women's needs, priorities and responsibilities related to climate change mitigation and adaptation - Taking into account the gender difference in mitigation and adaptation programs, technology transfer and capacity building - Achieving gender equality by providing equal access to credit and access to training for projects related to climate change mitigation and adaptation
section_header: Objective (2.g): Strengthening women›s response considerations to help them adapt to climate change
extraction_rationale: Gender-responsive adaptation and climate-finance access policy.

policy_statement: Create and update interactive climate-impact maps every five years.
source_quote: - Activating the project of creating and using interactive maps to study the expected impacts of climate change on regions and new projects and hence various sectors and updating interactive maps every five years as part of climate change adaptation measures, according to new data and methodologies
extraction_rationale: Specific adaptation planning tool with a five-year update cycle.

policy_statement: The Ministry of Health and Population will study expected climate-related health impacts and adopt an effective response plan.
source_quote: - The Ministry of Health and Population will study the expected health impacts as a result of climate change, and then develop and adopt a plan to address these impacts effectively.
extraction_rationale: Ministry-specific climate-health adaptation planning commitment.

policy_statement: Study sea-level-rise adaptation and coastal protection solutions for coasts and coastal cities.
source_quote: - Study different solutions to adapt to sea level rise and protect coasts and coastal cities such as construction and architectural interventions, including traditional and non-conventional engineering protection works
extraction_rationale: Specific coastal adaptation planning measure for sea-level rise.

policy_statement: Prioritize infrastructure-efficiency projects and sewage treatment coverage for the most vulnerable areas.
source_quote: - The Ministry of Planning giving priority to projects that raise the efficiency of infrastructure, especially very old ones, and increasing the coverage of services such as sewage treatment plants for the most vulnerable areas.
extraction_rationale: Prioritization policy for resilient infrastructure and vulnerable areas.

policy_statement: Prepare a timed action plan to maximize treatment and recycling of wastewater, industrial water, and agricultural water.
source_quote: - Building on the policies related to the water resources development and management strategy 2050 issued by the Ministry of Environmental Resources and Irrigation to prepare an action plan with a timetable to maximize the treatment and recycling of wastewater, industrial and agricultural
extraction_rationale: Concrete water recycling planning policy, though the source text appears truncated after 'agricultural'.

policy_statement: Develop rural community programs and policies to enhance climate resilience.
source_quote: - Developing programs and policies to support the development of rural communities to enhance their resilience to the impacts of climate change, especially land use change, plant and animal production, and the impact of migration to urban areas.
extraction_rationale: Specific adaptation policy for rural resilience.

policy_statement: Disseminate governorate-level climate change strategies to localize climate issues in planning and project implementation.
source_quote: - Disseminating climate change strategies similar to the Giza governorate strategy in a more comprehensive manner at the governorate level with the aim of localizing climate change issues at the local level during the regional planning and project implementation processes
extraction_rationale: Subnational climate planning policy.

policy_statement: Use climate risk insurance to increase communities' ability to overcome climate risks.
source_quote: - Using the climate risk insurance tool as one of the financial mechanisms that increase the ability of societies to overcome the risks of climate change.
extraction_rationale: Explicit climate risk insurance financial instrument.

policy_statement: Use artificial intelligence and remote sensing applications for climate-related farming and climate studies.
source_quote: - Exploiting the use of artificial intelligence to provide solutions to challenges facing farmers such as climate change, pest outbreaks and the spread of weeds that reduce yields - Coordinating with the Remote Sensing Authority to benefit from its applications in climate change studies
extraction_rationale: Specific technology applications for climate adaptation and studies.

policy_statement: Ensure women’s participation in climate-finance standards, resource allocation, data analysis, indicators, consultation, and action plans.
source_quote: - Creating policies that ensure the effective participation of women in setting financing standards and allocating resources for climate change initiatives - Developing policies that encourage a systematic analysis of gender equality, based on the collection and use of data disaggregated by gender, the development of gender-sensitive standards and indicators, and opinion surveys to assess the level of women's satisfaction in different governorates with the technology used in climate change initiatives
extraction_rationale: Gender-responsive climate governance and finance policy.

policy_statement: Define climate-action roles and responsibilities for stakeholders across ministries, governorates, and civil society.
source_quote: The importance of institutional integration between different sectors and ministries is increasing to deal with a complex issue like climate change. Therefore, objective 3.a sheds light to defining and distributing roles in a manner that commensurate with the current situation of conducting tasks and integrating with it.
section_header: Objective (3.a): Defining the roles and responsibilities of the different stakeholders in order to achieve the strategic goals
extraction_rationale: Institutional governance policy for climate action.

parent_statement: Defining the roles and responsibilities of the different stakeholders in order to achieve the strategic goals
policy_statement: Establish and develop climate change units in relevant ministries and risk management units in villages and remote areas.
source_quote: - Completing the establishment and development of the climate change units entrusted with dealing with the climate change file within all relevant ministries - Working to establish risk management units at the level of some villages and remote areas in the governorates
section_header: Objective (3.a): Defining the roles and responsibilities of the different stakeholders in order to achieve the strategic goals
extraction_rationale: Specific institutional climate governance structures.

parent_statement: Defining the roles and responsibilities of the different stakeholders in order to achieve the strategic goals
policy_statement: Localize climate issues in governorates and define their role in adaptation and mitigation projects.
source_quote: - Localizing climate change issues in different governorates and determining the role of the governorates in planning and implementing adaptation and mitigation projects and developing their capabilities
section_header: Objective (3.a): Defining the roles and responsibilities of the different stakeholders in order to achieve the strategic goals
extraction_rationale: Subnational planning and implementation policy.

parent_statement: Defining the roles and responsibilities of the different stakeholders in order to achieve the strategic goals
policy_statement: Develop climate information-sharing, data requirements, performance indicators, sectoral consultation, and civil-sector supervisory roles.
source_quote: - Developing a mechanism to share information on what has been achieved periodically in a way that ensures the integration of efforts among the different sectors - Determining the data required to be available from each ministry in order to ensure the clear availability of information - Encouraging the civil sector entrusted with environmental activities to play its supervisory and technical role in improving the governance and management of work in the field of climate change.
section_header: Objective (3.a): Defining the roles and responsibilities of the different stakeholders in order to achieve the strategic goals
extraction_rationale: Specific climate governance and information-management actions.

policy_statement: Improve Egypt’s international climate-action profile to attract investments and climate finance.
source_quote: To implement the proposed projects and develop monitoring and control systems in the various sectors as well as at the state level, the necessary funding must be provided to support development at all levels. This comes through international grants and loans that support mitigation and adaptation projects, or through internal financing when sources of income are available.
section_header: Objective (3.b): Improving the rank of Egypt in the international profile of climate change actions to attract further investments and climate finance opportunities
extraction_rationale: Climate finance and investment-attraction objective with reporting actions; not itself a financial instrument.

parent_statement: Improving the rank of Egypt in the international profile of climate change actions to attract further investments and climate finance opportunities
policy_statement: Review ministry work plans, identify mitigation and adaptation projects, and report technical and financial progress in Egypt's biennial update report.
source_quote: - Reviewing the work plans of each ministry and identifying the listed mitigation and adaptation projects to ensure coordination of efforts made on the issue of climate change - Each ministry should report on the technical and financial progress of each of the projects identified above, and include all those projects in the biennially updated report for Egypt.
section_header: Objective (3.b): Improving the rank of Egypt in the international profile of climate change actions to attract further investments and climate finance opportunities
extraction_rationale: Specific coordination and reporting mechanism for climate projects.

policy_statement: Reform sectoral policies to capture required climate change mitigation and adaptation interventions.
source_quote: In order to support the effective implementation of the proposed sectoral measures, the necessary sectoral policies should be developed and reformed to ensure the involvement of the private sector and all relevant groups. The policies of the Ministry of Electricity and Energy to implement solar energy projects through the inclusion of various means (such as feed-in tariffs, public auction and net metering system) is a successful example of encouraging the inclusion of the private sector in the implementation of mitigation projects.
section_header: Objective (3.c): Sectoral policy reform to capture the required climate change mitigation and adaptation interventions
extraction_rationale: Policy reform objective for climate implementation, referencing concrete mechanisms.

parent_statement: Sectoral policy reform to capture the required climate change mitigation and adaptation interventions
policy_statement: Establish implementation, adoption, private-sector participation, and review mechanisms for climate-related policies.
source_quote: - Ensure that a clear implementation mechanism is in place for existing policies - Discuss the proposed policies to implement the priority measures and adopting what has been agreed upon - Involve the private sector and relevant groups in discussing the proposed policies to ensure their effective implementation
section_header: Objective (3.c): Sectoral policy reform to capture the required climate change mitigation and adaptation interventions
extraction_rationale: Specific climate policy-reform implementation actions.

policy_statement: Enhance institutional, procedural and legal arrangements for climate MRV systems.
source_quote: Monitoring, reporting and verification system is a major axis in measuring the effectiveness of the specific strategic objectives. It is also one of the most effective tools in enhancing Egypt›s rank in the international profile of climate change actions to attract further investments and climate finance opportunities.
section_header: Objective (3.d): Enhancing institutional, procedural and legal arrangements such as Monitoring, Reporting and Verification (MRV) system
extraction_rationale: Climate MRV governance policy.

parent_statement: Enhancing institutional, procedural and legal arrangements such as Monitoring, Reporting and Verification (MRV) system
policy_statement: Operationalize the climate change MRV system, update climate-related statistics, and develop institutional structures such as an emissions inventory system or carbon market regulator.
source_quote: - Operationalizing the climate change MRV system, which was approved by the NCCC and included in the updated biennial report for Egypt (2018) - Updating the statistical data collected by the Central Agency for Public Mobilization and Statistics (CAPMAS), to include more data related to climate change. - Developing a number of institutional structures in the future, such as establishing an emission inventory system centrally in Egypt or a regulatory body for carbon markets if it is decided to establish them in Egypt
section_header: Objective (3.d): Enhancing institutional, procedural and legal arrangements such as Monitoring, Reporting and Verification (MRV) system
extraction_rationale: Specific MRV and emissions-governance actions.

policy_statement: Issue a Prime Minister decision forming climate-change committees in relevant ministries.
source_quote: - Issuing of a Prime-minister decision to form a committee within each of the ministries relevant to climate change to be responsible for managing this file in light of the guidelines of the NCCC
extraction_rationale: Binding executive governance mechanism.

policy_statement: Provide climate-change training and technical capacity building for ministry staff and governorate risk-management departments.
source_quote: - Providing training and raising the technical capabilities of employees in ministries, especially with regard to concepts and calculations related to climate change - Each governorate to determine the training needs required for members of the risk management department, and the CCCD prepares the required plan to implement such trainings
extraction_rationale: Specific capacity-building policy for climate governance and risk management.

policy_statement: Issue NCCC mandates clarifying ministry roles and responsibilities, including coordination with governorates.
source_quote: - Issuing a clear mandate from the NCCC for each of the relevant ministries clarifying all roles and responsibilities, including coordination with the governorates
extraction_rationale: Institutional mandate for climate governance.

policy_statement: Prepare annual and biennial report templates for technical and financial progress on mitigation and adaptation projects.
source_quote: - Preparing forms and templates for annual reports and biennial reports that are required to be filled out by the relevant ministries to summarize the progress of technical and financial work related to mitigation and adaptation projects
extraction_rationale: Concrete MRV reporting mechanism.

policy_statement: Enact laws and regulations to address climate change.
source_quote: - Enacting laws and regulations to address climate change
extraction_rationale: Regulatory commitment, though details are unspecified.

policy_statement: Promote local green banking and green credit lines.
source_quote: The banking sector is one of the most important sources of project financing in the private and public sectors. The banking entity sets a set of requirements that the recipient of support must comply with before approving the financing. Those set of requirements can include environmental and social aspects to turn those investments into green ones.
section_header: Objective (4.a): Promoting local green banking and green credit lines
extraction_rationale: Climate finance objective with banking and lending sub-actions.

parent_statement: Promoting local green banking and green credit lines
policy_statement: Develop a comprehensive national climate finance plan and increase environmental and social financing requirements.
source_quote: - Developing a comprehensive national strategic plan for climate finance that detail the mechanisms to be used - Encouraging the increase in environmental and social requirements in financing requirements such as climate risk assessments, environmental impact assessments, and sustainability feasibility studies
section_header: Objective (4.a): Promoting local green banking and green credit lines
extraction_rationale: Climate finance planning and lending requirement policy.

parent_statement: Promoting local green banking and green credit lines
policy_statement: Build banking-sector competencies, use international financing programs for lending, and study increased facilitations for climate projects.
source_quote: - Ensuring the presence of the required competencies in the banking sector to follow up on the existence and implementation of the financing requirements - Benefiting from international financing programs to provide lending programs in a manner that fulfills the conditions of the lenders - Studying increasing facilitations to climate change projects
section_header: Objective (4.a): Promoting local green banking and green credit lines
extraction_rationale: Financial capacity and lending facilitation policy.

policy_statement: Promote innovative financing mechanisms prioritizing adaptation actions, including green bonds.
source_quote: During the second half of 2020, Egypt issued its first green bond offering with a value of 750 million dollars. Thus, Egypt was the pioneer in issuing these bonds at the level of the Middle East and Africa. Green bonds aim to attract investors who are working on sustainable projects as they are intended for projects related to the environment and climate.
section_header: Objective (4.b): Promoting innovative financing mechanisms prioritizing adaptation actions, e.g., green bonds
extraction_rationale: Explicit financial instrument objective.

parent_statement: Promoting innovative financing mechanisms prioritizing adaptation actions, e.g., green bonds
policy_statement: Develop green bonds, results-based financing, green finance for MSMEs, and financing for vulnerable areas and women.
source_quote: - Encouraging the development of green bonds to cover sectors that have not yet been operated - Encouraging the development of innovative financing mechanisms such as 'resultsbased financing' which reduce the risk of lenders - Providing green financing opportunities to micro, small and medium enterprises
section_header: Objective (4.b): Promoting innovative financing mechanisms prioritizing adaptation actions, e.g., green bonds
extraction_rationale: Specific climate finance instruments and access measures.

parent_statement: Promoting innovative financing mechanisms prioritizing adaptation actions, e.g., green bonds
policy_statement: Provide technical and financial support for small and micro projects and use easy-term loan models linked to training programs.
source_quote: - Seeking to provide technical and financial support, especially to small and micro projects, in order to raise the efficiency of the affected groups through developing projects eligible for financing. - Benefiting from some international experiences in innovative financing mechanisms for small projects, where easy terms are offered for the loan in exchange for a specific training program that reduces the risks of the financing entity
section_header: Objective (4.b): Promoting innovative financing mechanisms prioritizing adaptation actions, e.g., green bonds
extraction_rationale: Financial support and loan instrument for climate-vulnerable groups and projects.

policy_statement: Engage the private sector in climate finance and promote green jobs.
source_quote: The Egyptian state has shown good handling of the crisis as a whole, but due to the ease of making rapid changes, the private sector has contributed to facing the challenges of the crisis. This shows the importance of the sector›s participation in financing climate activities.
section_header: Objective (4.c): Private sector engagement in climate finance and promotion of green jobs
extraction_rationale: Climate finance objective with private-sector incentive sub-actions.

parent_statement: Private sector engagement in climate finance and promotion of green jobs
policy_statement: Provide private-sector tax facilitations, export-support environmental standards, credit guarantees, and public-private partnerships for green investments.
source_quote: - Reaching an agreement that enables the private sector to obtain tax facilitations, for example, or other advantages, such as adopting environmental standards and including these standards in export support packages, providing credit guarantees to enhance private investments in green fields, and strengthening public-private partnerships in this framework.
section_header: Objective (4.c): Private sector engagement in climate finance and promotion of green jobs
extraction_rationale: Specific financial incentives and guarantees.

parent_statement: Private sector engagement in climate finance and promotion of green jobs
policy_statement: Direct private-sector CSR activities toward adaptation projects with environmental civil society organizations.
source_quote: - Directing the private sector so that its Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) activities include adaptation projects in partnership with civil society organizations responsible for environmental activities
section_header: Objective (4.c): Private sector engagement in climate finance and promotion of green jobs
extraction_rationale: Specific private-sector adaptation finance/channeling measure.

policy_statement: Comply with Multilateral Development Bank guidelines for climate finance.
source_quote: The Multi-lateral Development Banks (MDB) have added a number of requirements related to climate activities to fund projects. These requirements must be taken into account to facilitate obtaining the funding required to support the work planned to be achieved with high efficiency to ensure continuous improvement in procedures.
section_header: Objective 4.d: Compliance with Multilateral Development Banks (MDB) guidelines for climate finance
extraction_rationale: Climate finance compliance objective linked to funding access, but it is a procedural commitment rather than a financial instrument itself.

parent_statement: Compliance with Multilateral Development Banks (MDB) guidelines for climate finance
policy_statement: Analyze MDB climate guidelines, conduct a gap analysis, and prioritize compliant projects and programs for bank financing.
source_quote: - Analyzing MDB guidelines requirements for climate activities - Making a detailed gap analysis that shows the current situation and the actions required for compliance - Giving priority to projects and programs compatible with the new requirements in submitting offers for obtaining financing from the relevant banks.
section_header: Objective 4.d: Compliance with Multilateral Development Banks (MDB) guidelines for climate finance
extraction_rationale: Specific climate finance compliance and prioritization actions.

policy_statement: Build on successful climate finance programs to develop future financing policies.
source_quote: According to the above mentioned, Egypt has already achieved successes in the field of financing climate activities, by offering green bonds, for example, and by implementing policies to involve the private sector in projects for financing solar power plants, such as the Benban plant, which is currently the largest solar power plant using solar energy (Photovoltaic cells) and other projects. That is why it is necessary to learn from previous successes to repeat them and to know the obstacles that were faced in order to avoid them.
section_header: Objective (4.e): Building on success of the current climate finance programs
extraction_rationale: Umbrella climate finance policy using successful models; procedural rather than a standalone financial instrument.

parent_statement: Building on success of the current climate finance programs
policy_statement: Study successful climate finance projects, develop financing-program guidelines, and replicate effective financing policies across sectors.
source_quote: - Studying successful projects that have been implemented on the ground to know the strengths and weaknesses that can be benefited from in the future - Developing a number of plans based on these projects to serve as guidelines for the financing programs under construction - Encouraging the development of financing policies similar to those whose effectiveness has been proven and disseminated in the various sectors in accordance with the nature of each sector
section_header: Objective (4.e): Building on success of the current climate finance programs
extraction_rationale: Specific finance policy replication and guideline-development actions.

policy_statement: The NCCC will coordinate with the banking sector on increased facilitations for climate change projects.
source_quote: - The NCCC to coordinate with the banking sector, regarding the study of increasing facilitations to climate change projects.
extraction_rationale: Specific climate finance facilitation policy, though framed as a study.

policy_statement: The NCCC will identify priority adaptation and mitigation programs for the Green Bond Plan.
source_quote: - The NCCC to identify priority adaptation and mitigation programs for inclusion in the Green Bond Plan
extraction_rationale: Specific green bond allocation policy.

policy_statement: The NCCC will prepare a time-limited plan for MDB guideline compliance and direct ministries to appropriate funding bodies.
source_quote: - The NCCC to study the requirements of the guidelines for MDBs, making a clear plan with a time-limit to comply with them, and directing each ministry to the most appropriate funding bodies.
extraction_rationale: Climate finance compliance and coordination policy with a time-limit.

policy_statement: Build on Law No. 152 of 2020 on MSME development for the most affected groups, including women in the poorest areas.
source_quote: - Building on Law No. 152 of 2020 regarding the development of MSMEs, especially with the most affected groups, such as women in the poorest areas
extraction_rationale: Uses an existing legal and finance-related mechanism to target climate-affected groups; climate linkage is through the climate finance section.

policy_statement: Strengthen scientific research and technology transfer for climate change mitigation and adaptation.
source_quote: Scientific research can contribute to a number of areas related to climate change, such as analyzing climate phenomena, predicting expected changes and developing plans to address them, whether with various mitigation or adaptation measures, after studying the effects of plans in detail. The transfer of technology complements the goal by ensuring that research results are implemented on the ground, as well as benefiting from the experiences of others in the same field and developing what has been reached.
section_header: Objective (5.a): Strengthening the role of scientific research and technology transfer in climate change mitigation and adaptation
extraction_rationale: Umbrella climate research and technology-transfer objective.

parent_statement: Strengthening the role of scientific research and technology transfer in climate change mitigation and adaptation
policy_statement: Establish a national entity to coordinate interdisciplinary climate change research.
source_quote: - Establish a national entity to coordinate interdisciplinary research efforts aimed at improving understanding of and response to climate change.
section_header: Objective (5.a): Strengthening the role of scientific research and technology transfer in climate change mitigation and adaptation
extraction_rationale: Specific institutional research coordination action.

parent_statement: Strengthening the role of scientific research and technology transfer in climate change mitigation and adaptation
policy_statement: Use scientific research for disaster prediction, emergency response, climate early warning to 2050, and abnormal phenomena.
source_quote: - Activating the role of scientific research in long-term planning for disaster prediction and emergency response and prediction and early warning of climatic elements until 2050 and the expected impacts on different sectors - Conducting research to find out and explain abnormal phenomena
section_header: Objective (5.a): Strengthening the role of scientific research and technology transfer in climate change mitigation and adaptation
extraction_rationale: Research actions for climate hazard prediction and adaptation.

parent_statement: Strengthening the role of scientific research and technology transfer in climate change mitigation and adaptation
policy_statement: Increase climate-change programs in universities and increase and prioritize funding for climate-change research.
source_quote: - Encouraging an increase in climate change-related programs in universities - Increasing funding opportunities for research projects in the field of climate change - Giving funding priority to research projects related to climate change
section_header: Objective (5.a): Strengthening the role of scientific research and technology transfer in climate change mitigation and adaptation
extraction_rationale: Education and funding policy for climate research.

parent_statement: Strengthening the role of scientific research and technology transfer in climate change mitigation and adaptation
policy_statement: Develop foreign research partnerships and multidisciplinary research teams for forecasting and emergency response.
source_quote: - Benefiting from partnerships with foreign research bodies to increase cooperation in forecasting and emergency response research - Promoting cooperation between different research bodies and encouraging the creation of research teams composed of different fields (multidisciplinary) to enhance the benefit of research
section_header: Objective (5.a): Strengthening the role of scientific research and technology transfer in climate change mitigation and adaptation
extraction_rationale: Specific research cooperation and capacity-building actions for climate response.

policy_statement: Facilitate climate-relevant information dissemination and knowledge management among government institutions and citizens.
source_quote: In order to maximize the benefit from the efforts, the strategy emphasizes the need to encourage coordination and communication between research and government agencies and decision makers. The following directions contribute to achieving this objective:
section_header: Objective (5.b): Facilitating the dissemination of climate-relevant information and knowledge management among government institutions and citizens
extraction_rationale: Umbrella climate knowledge-management policy.

parent_statement: Facilitating the dissemination of climate-relevant information and knowledge management among government institutions and citizens
policy_statement: Establish a unified database and coordination mechanisms for exchanging climate research among ministries, universities, research institutes, and decision makers.
source_quote: - Establishing a unified database for the exchange of research efforts between ministries, universities and various research institutes - Encouraging coordination between various research bodies such as institutes, universities and centers and exchanging experiences and research results - Reducing the gap between scientific research bodies, government agencies and decision makers
section_header: Objective (5.b): Facilitating the dissemination of climate-relevant information and knowledge management among government institutions and citizens
extraction_rationale: Specific climate knowledge-management and coordination action.

policy_statement: Raise climate change awareness among policy makers, citizens, students, and other stakeholders.
source_quote: Increasing awareness contributes to achieving readiness to deal with any potential threat in a correct manner. It also produces a generation that has sufficient awareness of the dimensions of the issue and thus can increase the effectiveness of the mechanisms required to address the impacts of climate change.
section_header: Objective (5.c): Raising awareness on climate change among different stakeholders (high-level policy/decision makers, citizens, and students)
extraction_rationale: Umbrella climate awareness and education policy.

parent_statement: Raising awareness on climate change among different stakeholders (high-level policy/decision makers, citizens, and students)
policy_statement: Prepare climate-change training programs for policy makers and public awareness campaigns.
source_quote: - Preparing specialized training programs for policy makers on climate change - Increasing national campaigns aimed at raising awareness among different segments of society about the importance of preserving the environment and natural resources, and modifying citizens' behavior towards the various elements of the environment.
section_header: Objective (5.c): Raising awareness on climate change among different stakeholders (high-level policy/decision makers, citizens, and students)
extraction_rationale: Specific capacity-building and awareness interventions.

parent_statement: Raising awareness on climate change among different stakeholders (high-level policy/decision makers, citizens, and students)
policy_statement: Prepare citizen climate-risk awareness campaigns, educational packages for school students, and use modern communications for awareness.
source_quote: - Preparing awareness campaigns for citizens about the dangers of climate change and the effects that may accompany it and the efforts made to address it with the participation and cooperation of all relevant institutions and stakeholders (schools, universities, all educational institutions, mosques, churches, media of all kinds, especially dramas and cinemas) and civil society, taking into account clearly defining roles where the media implements the mechanisms of a comprehensive national plan to educate society about the risks and negative impacts resulting from climate changes and related to various matters, including water provision, unemployment, food security and the citizen›s positive role to reduce these risks
section_header: Objective (5.c): Raising awareness on climate change among different stakeholders (high-level policy/decision makers, citizens, and students)
extraction_rationale: Specific nationwide awareness and education campaign for climate risks.

policy_statement: Include climate change issues and awareness of their effects as an essential part of school education programs.
source_quote: - Ministry of Education to put climate change issues and raising awareness of its effects as an essential part of school education programs
extraction_rationale: Specific school curriculum policy.

policy_statement: Include climate change in university studies and postgraduate programs.
source_quote: - Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research to include the field of climate change in university studies and postgraduate programs
extraction_rationale: Specific higher-education curriculum policy.

policy_statement: Establish more climate-change research institutes and centers.
source_quote: - Encouraging the establishment of more research institutes and centers specialized in climate change issues, whether at the sectoral level or from multidisciplinary research groups
extraction_rationale: Specific institutional research-capacity policy.

policy_statement: Develop a system for communication between research centers and ministries to convert research into implementable projects.
source_quote: - The NCCS to develop a system that regulates communication between research centers and ministries so as to share research results until they are converted into projects ready for implementation.
extraction_rationale: Specific knowledge-to-implementation mechanism for climate projects.

policy_statement: Prepare climate change awareness materials for all ages and disseminate them through all communication means.
source_quote: - The Ministry of Environment, in cooperation with the Ministry of Social Solidarity, prepares awareness materials for all ages about climate change, and uses all means of communication to ensure that information reaches all citizens
extraction_rationale: Specific ministry-led climate awareness policy.

policy_statement: Ensure integrated planning between national and sectoral strategies.
source_quote: - Direction 1: Ensuring integrated planning between the different national and sectoral strategies (e.g., Sustainable Development Strategy - Egypt Vision 2030, Green Economy Strategy, National Strategy for Disaster Risk Reduction, Low Emissions Development Strategy, sectoral strategies like Sustainable Agriculture Strategy, etc.)
extraction_rationale: Cross-cutting climate planning policy referencing specific strategies.

policy_statement: Mainstream climate actions into national planning.
source_quote: - Direction 2: Mainstreaming climate actions into national planning
extraction_rationale: National planning mainstreaming commitment.

policy_statement: Integrate sustainability criteria and green recovery into national planning and budgeting.
source_quote: - Direction 3: Integrating sustainability criteria and green recovery into national planning and budgeting
extraction_rationale: Planning and budgeting policy for green recovery.

policy_statement: Integrate climate adaptation and resilience in infrastructure projects.
source_quote: - Direction 4: Integrating climate adaptation and resilience in infrastructure projects
extraction_rationale: Direct infrastructure adaptation mainstreaming policy.

policy_statement: Use financing opportunities under the UNFCCC, Paris Agreement, and other climate-related sources.
source_quote: - Direction 5: Utilizing financing opportunities under UNFCCC, Paris Agreement, and other climate related sources
extraction_rationale: Climate finance mobilization policy.

policy_statement: Use existing infrastructure to implement climate projects, including using the electricity grid for electric vehicles.
source_quote: - Direction 6: Capitalizing on existing infrastructure to implement new projects related to climate change, e.g., utilizing the existing modernized and enlarged electricity grid for powering electric vehicles
extraction_rationale: Specific mitigation-enabling infrastructure action.

policy_statement: Foster market competitiveness, economic diversity, and green jobs.
source_quote: - Direction 7: Fostering market competitiveness and economic diversity, as well as creating green jobs
extraction_rationale: Green-jobs economic direction; climate relevance is indirect because the mechanism is economic diversification rather than a direct emissions or resilience action.

policy_statement: Strengthen bilateral and multilateral cooperation with countries, financial institutions, and specialized agencies on climate-related areas of common interest.
source_quote: - Direction 8: Strengthening bilateral and multilateral cooperation with other countries, international financial institutions and specialized agencies in areas of common interest, such as the Nile Basin countries and others.
extraction_rationale: Cooperation policy supporting climate implementation and finance; broad but action-oriented.

policy_statement: Allocate approximately USD 211 billion for mitigation programs across industry, electricity, petroleum, transport, civil aviation, housing and utilities, and waste.
source_quote: Table 6.1: Summary of the Mitigation Programs Cost | Sector | Cost (million USD) | Time frame | | Industry | 130.3 | 2022/2035 | | Electricity | 144153 | 2021/2035 | | Total | USD 211132.4 million = USD 211 billion
section_header: 6 COST OF MITIGATION AND ADAPTATION PROGRAMS IN DIFFERENT SECTORS
extraction_rationale: Quantified resource allocation for mitigation programs.

policy_statement: Allocate approximately USD 113 billion for adaptation programs in agriculture, transport, civil aviation, irrigation and water resources, and biodiversity.
source_quote: Table 6.2:Summary of the Adaptation Programs Cost | Sector | Cost (million USD) | Time frame | | Agriculture | 52400 | 2022/2050 | | Irrigation and Water Resources | 59108.3 | 2022/2037 | | Total | million dollars = 113 billion dollars approximately 112990.4
extraction_rationale: Quantified resource allocation for adaptation programs.

policy_statement: Require ministries to prepare annual reports on progress toward NCCS goals and implementation of policies, tools, and directions.
source_quote: - It is proposed that each ministry, on an annual basis, will prepare an overview report covering where the ministry stands against achieving the specified goals and objectives, what was helpful and what are the main challenges encountered. - To ensure systematic and consistent reporting between the ministries, each ministry shall report on the status of implementing the policies, tools and directions that were covered in section 5 of the NCCS, and shall also propose new ones if needed.
extraction_rationale: Concrete annual monitoring and reporting commitment.

policy_statement: Have CCCD collect annual ministry reports and have the NCCC Executive Bureau assign a technical working group to analyze them.
source_quote: -  It is proposed that the CCCD which acts as the technical secretariat of the NCCC will be responsible for collecting such annual reports from the ministries. The NCCC's Executive Bureau will then assign a technical working group to analyze such reports, and develop a compiled presentation that will be presented in the NCCC annual meeting.
extraction_rationale: Specific institutional mechanism for annual climate strategy monitoring.

policy_statement: Require biennial ministry reporting on implementation of mitigation and adaptation actions, GHG reductions, and adaptation outcomes using standardized templates.
source_quote: - On a biennial basis, ministries will be responsible for reporting on the status of implementing the identified mitigation and adaptation actions and providing update for the new ones. - To ensure the consistency and quality control of the calculated GHG emission reduction, Table 7-1 contains a quantitative reporting template on mitigation actions tailored from Egypt's first Biennial Update Report (BUR). - For adaptation actions, ministries will report on the programs/projects implemented, status of implementation and the key outcomes.
extraction_rationale: Concrete biennial MRV reporting requirement for mitigation and adaptation.

policy_statement: Monitor NCCS indicators annually through ministry reporting to CCCD and presentation at NCCC annual meetings.
source_quote: Section 4 of the NCCS determined the indicators related to the goals and objectives of the strategy. As mentioned in section 7.2.1, the ministries will report to CCCD on an annual basis the results of measuring their indicators, and this will be presented in the NCCC annual meetings.
section_header: 7.2.3.1 Indicators related to the implementation of NCCS goals and objectives
extraction_rationale: Specific annual indicator monitoring mechanism for the climate strategy.

policy_statement: Fiji declares a climate emergency and establishes a whole-of-government climate response framework.
source_quote: 6. -(1)  This Act recognises and declares that Fiji and the Earth are facing a climate emergency. (6)  The purpose of this  Act is to set out a detailed framework for a whole of government approach to addressing the climate emergency in Fiji.
extraction_rationale: Statutory declaration and framework commitment for climate action.

policy_statement: The Minister must prepare, communicate and maintain successive NDCs and pursue domestic mitigation measures.
source_quote: (2)  The Minister must, in consultation with the Committee and in accordance with the Paris Agreement, noting the flexibility afforded to Fiji as a small island developing State, take all reasonable steps to- - (a) prepare,  communicate  and  maintain  successive  NDCs  that  the  Minister intends Fiji to achieve; - (b) pursue  domestic  mitigation  measures,  with  the aim of achieving the objectives of Fiji's NDC;
extraction_rationale: Binding ministerial duty to implement Paris Agreement mitigation commitments through NDCs.

policy_statement: The Minister may submit and periodically update an adaptation communication or National Adaptation Plan.
source_quote: (3)  The Minister may, with the assistance of the Director and in accordance with the Paris Agreement, submit and update periodically an adaptation communication or a NAP, which may include Fiji's adaptation priorities, implementation and support needs, plans and actions.
extraction_rationale: Concrete adaptation planning and reporting mechanism.

policy_statement: All ministers must promote sectoral emissions reduction or limitation targets in Fiji's NDC.
source_quote: 8. -(1)  All ministers must, where relevant and with the assistance of the Committee, take all reasonable steps within their portfolio to promote the achievement of any sectoral emissions reduction or limitation targets in Fiji's NDC.
section_header: Preparation and implementation of Fiji's Nationally Determined Contributions
extraction_rationale: Binding cross-government duty tied to sectoral emissions targets.

policy_statement: The Minister may formulate, implement and review national climate policies, guidelines, measures and instruments.
source_quote: 9. -(1)  The Minister has the power to- - (a) oversee  the  implementation  of  and  promote  compliance  with  this  Act, including by- - (ii) formulating,  implementing  and  reviewing  Fiji's  national  climate change policies and guidelines; and - (iii) formulating,  implementing  and  reviewing  measures  and  actions, including economic, fiscal, financial and market-based instruments as  required,  on  climate  change  mitigation,  adaptation,  climate displacement, planned relocation and oceans in accordance with this Act, the Paris Agreement, and other international treaties that Fiji has ratified relating to climate change;
extraction_rationale: Umbrella statutory authority with specific implementation powers listed beneath it.

parent_statement: Powers of the Minister
policy_statement: The Minister may encourage scientific research, technology development, transfer and deployment for climate mitigation and adaptation.
source_quote: - (b) implement measures to encourage scientific and technological research, the development, transfer and deployment of technologies, equipment and processes  for  climate  change  mitigation and  adaptation that are centred around the needs of end-users, with particular regard to marginalised and disadvantaged people;
extraction_rationale: Specific research and technology intervention for climate action.

parent_statement: Powers of the Minister
policy_statement: The Minister may convene ministries to mainstream mitigation, adaptation, displacement and planned relocation into development planning and policy.
source_quote: - (c) convene other ministries to support national efforts to mainstream climate change mitigation, adaptation, climate displacement and planned relocation into development planning, decision-making and policy;
extraction_rationale: Concrete whole-of-government climate mainstreaming mechanism.

parent_statement: Powers of the Minister
policy_statement: The Minister may develop standards and codes of practice to accelerate Fiji's climate response.
source_quote: (4)  The Minister may, in consultation with the relevant minister, develop standards and codes of practice as required to accelerate Fiji's response to climate change in accordance with the objectives and principles of this Act, Fiji's current NDC and other relevant policies.
extraction_rationale: Regulatory standard-setting power for climate response.

policy_statement: The Minister must review the Act every five years and annually report progress toward net zero and climate-resilient development.
source_quote: 10. -(1)  The Minister must review the implementation of this Act every 5 years, including with regard to progress made towards achieving the objectives and principles of this Act, and report to Parliament on the findings of the review. (4) The Minister must report annually to Parliament on the status of implementation of international and national obligations to respond to climate change and progress towards the attainment of net zero emissions and climate resilient development.
section_header: Obligation to report on and review the implementation of this Act
extraction_rationale: Mandatory review and parliamentary reporting requirement.

policy_statement: The Act establishes a National Climate Change Coordination Committee to coordinate and mainstream climate action.
source_quote: 12. -(1)  This  section  establishes  the  National  Climate Change Coordination Committee. - (g) to  advise  the  national  and  local  governments  including  the  provincial administrations  on  policy  and  other  measures  necessary  for  responding to climate change and promoting net zero emissions and climate resilient development;
extraction_rationale: Creates a statutory governance institution for net zero and resilient development coordination.

policy_statement: Each ministry must appoint a climate focal point and report biannually on implementation.
source_quote: 13. -(1)  The permanent secretary for each ministry must, in consultation with the Director, appoint a person from within their ministry as a focal point.
